name: Mobile-First Lukas
summary: Lukas is the premium segment. He will pay CHF 25–30/month for a card that genuinely delivers — zero foreign fees, comprehensive travel insurance, and automatic cashback. The pitch is not 'save money' but 'get more value from what you already spend.' Visa Infinite or equivalent is the right product tier.

key_metrics.top_feature: No foreign fees + travel insurance combo

price_sensitivity.finding: Value-driven, not price-sensitive. Immediately chooses CHF 8/month over 1.5% foreign fee — calculates break-even instinctively. Will pay for quality if the numbers work.
price_sensitivity.key_quote: The math clearly favors zero foreign fees.

feature_preference.finding: No foreign fees + travel insurance is the strongest combination — continuous value for a frequent traveller. Cashback attractive only if uncapped and simple.
feature_preference.key_quote: Foreign fees and insurance have continuous value.
tags: no foreign fees + travel insurance wins

behavior_switching.finding: Will switch if rewards are automatic and frictionless. Already keeps a credit card active — the bar is raising the value proposition, not overcoming resistance.
behavior_switching.key_quote: If I clearly see monthly net gains without changing behavior, I would switch.

trade_off.finding: Accepts net gain instantly — no hesitation at CHF 15 save / CHF 10 fee. Reliability matters more than the amount. Rejects welcome bonus as mathematically negative.
trade_off.key_quote: That is a clear net gain. As long as savings are consistent, I would accept without hesitation.

willingness_to_pay.finding: CHF 25–30/month is the ceiling, conditional on strong travel insurance, zero foreign fees, and at least CHF 30–40 equivalent monthly value. Would keep a free card as functional backup.
willingness_to_pay.key_quote: I would go up to CHF 25–30 per month, but only if the value clearly exceeds that.

visa_recommendation.viable_product: Premium Visa card — CHF 20–25/month with zero foreign fees + comprehensive travel insurance + 2% uncapped cashback
visa_recommendation.acquisition_trigger: Automatic value delivery — no effort required from the cardholder
